assign.outcome:
**Three pages pressed at five widths against the owner's polish sentences: found 20, fixed 20, left 1.** Every gesture driven headless, every number measured twice.

| page | found | fixed | left |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Color](/imagine/design/color/) | 8 | 8 | 1 |
| [Ask](/framework/ext/Ask/) | 6 | 6 | 0 |
| [Navigation](/imagine/design/navigation/) | 6 | 6 | 0 |

**The one that mattered most.** The navigation lab's *stable row* scrolled to the end on a press, which drove **450px of the middle column's 640 under the pinned rail** at 1280 — its head blank, its words cut mid-letter. The row that exists to prove nothing moved looked like the broken one of the two. It does not scroll now: the new column arrives as a 190px peek at the right edge, and 450px hidden became **0px** at every width.

![before](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/polish-critic/shots/nav-before.jpeg)
![after](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/polish-critic/shots/nav-after.jpeg)

**Color** — the live sentence was 923px above the two sliders that write it (2,073px at 400) and its "saturation decides nothing here" branch was a tautology whenever the slider sat at 0, telling a reader already at hue 240 to drag round to a blue. The sentence moved under its sliders and the claim is now computed at full and drained saturation, so it is true wherever the slider is. Also: the record fold's prose ran 3,342px at 3440, a slider track ran 1,670px, and the sentence's own `1.15em` made its measure 1.15x its neighbours'. [before](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/polish-critic/shots/color-before.jpeg) / [after](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/polish-critic/shots/color-after.jpeg) · [decisions](/imagine/design/color/decisions.md)

**Ask** — one pick printed **two 404s** in the console because the readme hunt guessed at synthetic page urls that own no files; a pick is now silent. The readout names both addresses, the chip quotes an element's own words instead of saying `h4`, and three links in the page's prose (`docs/...`, when the route is `doc/`) were dead. [before](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/polish-critic/shots/ask-before.jpeg) / [after](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/polish-critic/shots/ask-after.jpeg) · [picking](/framework/ext/Ask/doc/picking/) · [decisions](/framework/ext/Ask/doc/decisions/)

**Checked and sound, no change:** the floating **?** covers no glyph and no control at 400, 1280 or 3440 at five scroll positions. Six of the color page's ratios recomputed by hand matched to the decimal. The nav lab's two readouts agree with my own headless measurement of the same click at all five widths (129/225 at 1280, 0/0 in the stable row everywhere).

**Refuted:** widening the nav demo to 90rem made the slide gentle and cost the demo its subject — the *today* row then moved 26px and 36px instead of the real site's 129px and 225px. Reverted the same hour.

**Left, one:** at 400 the color sentence is five lines for some hues and six for others, so the five accent tiles under it move 21px on a drag (down from 42px page-wide). `min-height` reserves five lines, the tallest it gets at 1280 and above; reserving seven would put two lines of permanent white on every wider screen.

Final sweep, three pages x five widths: zero console errors, zero prose past the measure, zero clipped boxes, nothing at x:0, every link resolves.
